headlines.title: Growth in China’s factory-gate prices accelerates, but consumer inflation subdued
headlines.summary:
Growth in Chinese factory-gate prices continued to accelerate last month, while consumer price growth remained subdued despite Beijing’s efforts to shore up domestic demand and support the economy in meeting its annual growth target.
The producer price index (PPI) rose 5 per cent year on year in September, the highest rate since mid-2022, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Wednesday. It rose by 3.8 per cent in August.

headlines.title_zh: 中国工业生产者出厂价格涨幅加快，但消费者通胀低迷
headlines.summary_zh:
中国出厂价格上月继续加速上涨，而尽管北京方面努力提振国内需求并支持经济实现年度增长目标，消费者价格涨幅仍保持低迷。
数据显示，9月份生产者价格指数（PPI）同比上涨5%，为2022年年中以来的最高水平。

headlines.title: IMF revises China GDP projection down this year, cautions on export reliance
headlines.summary:
The International Monetary Fund has trimmed its projection of China’s economic growth in 2026 by 0.1 percentage point to 4.5 per cent, cautioning that resilient exports are no longer sufficient to fully offset persistent weakness in domestic demand.
The revised projection sits at the lower end of Beijing’s annual growth target for this year, down from the previous forecast of 4.6 per cent in July, according to the organisation’s latest World Economic Outlook, released on Tuesday.

headlines.title_en: Azerbaijan President Aliyev meets Wang Yi
headlines.summary_en: Azerbaijani President Aliyev met in Baku on the 14th with Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister. The Chinese side congratulated Azerbaijan on its flourishing national development cause under President Aliyev's leadership, supported Azerbaijan in following a development path suited to its national conditions, and is willing to strengthen Middle Corridor cooperation with Azerbaijan and other parties and continue to be a trustworthy long-term strategic partner in Azerbaijan's development process. The Chinese side thanked Azerbaijan for its long-standing strong support on issues involving China's core interests and also supports Azerbaijan in safeguarding independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity. China's development is an enhancement of the strength of the Global South and the growth of developing countries, and China is willing to continue close coordination and cooperation with Azerbaijan to safeguard the common interests of Global South countries. The Chinese side supports Azerbaijan in playing an important role in multilateral platforms such as CICA and in international affairs, and in making more contributions to regional and world peace and stability. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 茶百道：全力配合香港证监会处理其任何关注事项 业务营运维持正常
headlines.summary: 茶百道在港交所公告，本公司董事会董事会注意到，香港证监会已于10月13日上午九时正起暂停本公司H股买卖。香港证监会表示，其关注本公司的首次公开发售可能曾被人为操纵，以营造对股份需求的假象。本公司董事会高度重视此事，并坚信遵守所有适用于本公司的法律及法规至关重要。因此，本公司正就该指令紧急寻求法律意见，并将努力处理及解决香港证监会关注的事项。本公司承诺全力配合香港证监会处理其任何关注事项，并将适时另行刊发公告。本公司确认，本集团的业务营运维持正常，且截至本公告日期，本集团的业务营运并无发生重大变动。

headlines.title_en: ChaPanda: Fully cooperating with the Hong Kong SFC on any concerns, business operations remain normal
headlines.summary_en: ChaPanda announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange that the company's board of directors notes that the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has suspended trading in the company's H shares from 9:00 a.m. on October 13. The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission said it is concerned that the company's initial public offering may have been artificially manipulated to create a false appearance of demand for the shares. The company's board of directors attaches great importance to this matter and firmly believes that compliance with all laws and regulations applicable to the company is crucial. Therefore, the company is urgently seeking legal advice regarding the directive and will work to address and resolve the concerns of the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission. The company is committed to fully cooperating with the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission in handling any of its concerns and will publish further announcements in due course. The company confirms that the group's business operations remain normal and that as of the date of this announcement there have been no material changes in the group's business operations.
